title: Bhakti-Sufi impact: sects, music and limits

boxes.title: Followers → tradition
head: Follower(s) of
Tradition
rows: Gupta rulers; Chalukya rulers of Eastern Vengi

boxes.title: Interaction: other points
items: **Nizamuddin Auliya**: yogic body split - **Siva** (head to navel), **Sakti** (below)
Akbar: pilgrimages to **Ajmer**; Tukaram, Ramdas: Maratha movement
Also shared: vernacular preaching, spiritual equality of castes
Rishi movement: universal love, served all castes

boxes.title: Society: added detail
items: Low-caste saints: Kabir weaver, Ravidas tanner, Sena barber, ==**Namdev tailor**==
Basava: also against **animal sacrifice**; Andhra via **Mallikarjuna, Inpati, Manchana** Panditas
Khanqahs fed and sheltered the poor; rulers sought Sufi blessings for **legitimacy**
Sufis preached in **Hindavi, Punjabi, Urdu**; Punjabi **Sufi kafis**

boxes.title: Limitations & debates
items: Medieval norms: purdah, limited education and work for women, lower castes
**Bulleh Shah** (Feb **2026**): Tariqat over Shariat; ==**Kafi** style==; guide **Shah Inayat Qadiri**
